arguments.sql: SELECT m.mcc AS mcc_code, c.description AS category, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM transactions t JOIN merchants m ON t.merchant_id = m.id JOIN mcc_codes c ON m.mcc = c.mcc GROUP BY m.mcc, c.description ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, m.mcc ASC LIMIT 3
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions by merchant category code and returns the three with the most, highest first, with their descriptions.
assumptions: Counts all transactions, labelled or not, since the question does not restrict to labelled rows.
Ties in count are broken by lower MCC code first.
